name: Merstham Recreation Ground
description: Listed in Reigate and Banstead Borough Council's parks and recreation directory. Facilities: open space, playing pitches, play area (all ages), toilets and changing rooms, parkour course for over 12s, outdoor gym, tennis court and multi-use games area, picnic area, pathways for wheelchairs and buggies, pavilion and café kiosk (opening soon).
